name: StreamIndicator
title: Citizen stream observation signs
description: Plain-language signs a citizen can report at an urban stream, for One Health surveillance. Intended to be mapped to the OneAquaHealth Indicators Framework.

concept.display: Algal scum or green discoloured water
concept.definition: Visible surface scum or green/blue-green discolouration, a possible algal bloom.
A strong septic, chemical or rotten smell noticed at the bank.
One or more dead or visibly distressed fish in or at the edge of the water.

concept.display: Oily or rainbow sheen on the surface
concept.definition: A rainbow or silvery film on the surface that breaks up into patches.
Water that is not flowing: ponded side pools, blocked channel or standing water.
Many mosquitoes or larvae seen at the site; a possible vector habitat signal.
Grey water, toilet paper, or a pipe discharging into the stream.

concept.display: Litter in or beside the channel
concept.definition: Plastic, bags or dumped items in the channel or on the banks.
White or brown foam that does not break up quickly.
The observer checked the site and saw nothing of concern. Credited equally.

text.div: Citizen stream observation signs: algal-scum (Algal scum or green discoloured water), odour (Unusual odour from the water), dead-fish (Dead or dying fish), oil-sheen (Oily or rainbow sheen on the surface), stagnant-water (Stagnant or ponded water), mosquitoes (High mosquito activity), sewage (Sewage or pipe discharge), litter (Litter in or beside the channel), foam (Persistent foam on the surface), all-clear (No problem observed)
